event.title: Prepare opt-in private Babid audit tests on public Analytics GitHub Actions
event.summary: Workflow checks a least-privilege read token before privately checking out Babid C Cloud to run synthetic Python tests on Linux and Windows. When token is absent tests are explicitly NOT TESTED; no private code is committed to Analytics.

changes.summary: Safe conditional cross-repository private checkout and synthetic test matrix; no live broker or artifacts.
Documents public/private isolation, token setup, limitations and explicit skip behavior.

checks.title: Cross-repository GitHub Actions run
checks.summary: Workflow staging; result must be read after push. Actual private test run requires BABIDCLOUD_READ_TOKEN.

issues.title: Analytics Actions cannot read private Babid without a read-only token
issues.description: An explicit user-created fine-grained token is needed; never request its value in chat.

next_actions.title: Inspect triggered workflow and verify whether private tests ran or were skipped

limitations: No private code, trading logs or credentials are published to Analytics.
No live trading; no default-branch changes.
